newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Lenzing up on hopes of recovery in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Lenzing up on hopes of recovery in 1998.

text.p: Shares in viscose fibre maker Lenzing jumped 5.22 percent to a year-high in Vienna on Thursday after the loss-making firm said it expected to return to profit in 1998.
At 1052 GMT Lenzing shares were 46 schillings up at 928 on volume of 28,412.
"It really looks as though the dead has risen," said one trader, referring to the unusually high turnover in Lenzing's normally illiquid shares.
On Monday, Lenzing chief executive Heinrich Stepniczka forecast the firm would start making money again next year.
"The turn-around has arrived, why shouldn't Lenzing shares break above 1,000 schillings?" asked a second dealer.
